## Evaluation campaign

- Campaign file: `data/submissions/<campaign-id>.json`
- Benchmark commit:
- Raw Oracle artifacts:
- Attacker settings and evaluation budget:

Use the benchmark's fixed victim configuration. Specify only `victim.range`
in the campaign file; the victim model is supplied by the range catalog.
See [the submission guide](https://github.com/greyzone-bench/greyzone-bench.github.io/blob/main/data/submissions/README.md).
